description: Search UK tariff-rate quotas (TRQs) — the limited volumes of a good that may be imported at a reduced or zero duty rate. Returns each quota definition with its order number, initial volume, REMAINING BALANCE, measurement unit, validity window, status (Open/Exhausted/Blocked) and the origins it applies to. AUTHORITATIVE for "is the UK quota for X still open", "how much of the New Zealand lamb quota is left". Sourced from HMRC's UK Integrated Online Tariff. Example: uktariff_quota({ year: 2026, geographical_area_id: "NZ" })

critical.description: Only quotas flagged critical (nearly exhausted, stricter licensing)

geographical_area_id.description: Origin country or area code, e.g. "NZ", "AU"

goods_nomenclature_item_id.description: 10-digit commodity code the quota applies to, e.g. "0201300000"

limit.description: Maximum quota definitions to return (default 25, max 100)

year.description: Quota year, e.g. 2026. Strongly recommended — without a filter the search is the whole register

name: uktariff_quota
title: Uktariff Quota
